ownerFullName: V I K T O R I A V A R G A

caption:
VIKTORIAVARGA doesn’t follow fashion. It listens to inner voices. It tells stories through colour and speaks through details. It celebrates the freedom of self-expression.

Every piece is made in our own studio - by hand, slowly, with intention. I design for those who value detail, storytelling, and authenticity.

I’m deeply committed to colour and bold layering - to me, dressing is self-expression. Many call what I do colour therapy, and I’m proud of that.

Our signature techniques - hand-stitched pom-poms, silk ribbon embroidery, hand-painting, sculpted organza - transform garments into wearable art, celebrating self-expression in its boldest, most beautiful form.

Discover your personal colour identity with #vvwomen!

#viktoriavarga

caption:
March, but make it iconic 🤍
So excited to share my cover and feature with L’Amour Magazine — a project that felt powerful in every sense.
The March ‘Must Chic’ edition feels especially meaningful, not only for this moment, but also as it coincides with International Women’s Day — and I couldn’t be prouder to have worked alongside such an incredible all-female team. The energy, creativity, and intention behind this project is something you can truly feel.
Working with Anna Vinterfall was an experience in itself — her cinematic, almost dreamlike approach to photography transforms every frame into a story.
And wearing Viktoria Varga’s designs felt like stepping into art — each piece sculptural, feminine, and undeniably powerful.
A celebration of women, creativity, and collaboration — and a moment I won’t forget ✨
